L31: # Collections and Finding Aids
L32: 
L33: The archival records in the Shelby White and Leon Levy Archives Center include official correspondence of the Director's Office, minutes of meetings of the Faculty and the Board of Trustees, correspondence concerning past Faculty and Members, records of the Electronic Computer Project, and papers of select Faculty members. The archives also include the Institute's photograph collection and a growing oral history collection.
